svg.aria-label: Root locus of K(s + 4) over s(s squared + 2s + 5): one branch runs on the real axis from 0 to the zero at minus 4; the other two leave the poles minus 1 plus or minus j2 at 7.1 degrees and follow vertical asymptotes through plus 1, crossing the imaginary axis at plus or minus j3.16 when K = 5
svg.title: Root locus of K(s + 4) over s(s squared + 2s + 5): one branch runs on the real axis from 0 to the zero at minus 4; the other two leave the poles minus 1 plus or minus j2 at 7.1 degrees and follow vertical asymptotes through plus 1, crossing the imaginary axis at plus or minus j3.16 when K = 5

g.text: × poles 0, −1 ± j2 · ○ zero −4 · dashed: asymptotes at ±90° through σa = +1
